selection_policy: Use the saved explicit user selection. Show requested and observed values separately. Never change providers on refusal, policy, access, timeout or local availability errors.
observation_policy: These contracts report the last operation only. They do not authorize or gate the next operation. The first useful user-selected operation may use the host's appropriate credentials and task scope, then supply its receipt; missing or expired observations do not require a separate verification ping.

project_bindings.workspace_project_id: Required for local and cloud selections; controls engagement data scope.
project_bindings.api_project_id: Required for OpenAI API selections, null for local Ollama; separate from the workspace project.

host_managed_surfaces.CHATGPT: Keep the existing private MPC plugins and the user's selected offering; observe actual model and access in that host. These API request fields do not configure ChatGPT.
host_managed_surfaces.CODEX: Use existing supported Codex sign-in and MCP registration. Observe the selected model and access separately. These API request fields do not configure Codex.
